svg.text: Step 1: Energy Harvesting & Management - Rooftop solar canopy harvests solar energy,
mediated by an MPPT charge controller and stored in high-capacity onboard battery banks to
Step 2: User Check-in & Intake - Commuter approaches kiosk at transit terminal and selects
service category (mobile tech, quick solder, tire inflation/patch, micro-mobility tune-up)
Step 3: Rapid Diagnostics - Device or item is placed in a multi-sensor diagnostic bay, which
scans for battery health, continuity, hardware faults, or tire pressure.
Step 4: Automated Quote & Approval - Kiosk generates instantaneous price/repair-time
estimate; commuter authorizes transaction via contactless mobile payment (Apple Pay, RFID
Step 5: Robotic/Assisted Repair Execution - Internal automated robotic arm or assisted
workbench tooling executes targeted repair (battery swap, screen patch, inflation, plug
Step 6: Quality Verification & Pickup - Optical and electrical verification runs; commuter
receives an authentication PIN or QR code to retrieve the repaired item from the retrieval
